Biostimulators: Collagen-Stimulating Treatments Explained

Biostimulators are a broad category of products intended to stimulate a tissue response, such as collagen production, for selected indications. Their ingredients, mechanisms, authorised uses and safety profiles vary considerably.

Because this category is broad, it is important to identify products accurately and to distinguish their approved uses from experimental or unsupported claims. This page is intended as a starting point for a specific conversation at consultation.
